title: Turn your slack threads into a podcast - Meet Wordware’s “Slack → Podcast” AI agent
summary: Convert busy Slack channels into an auto-generated podcast you can stream anywhere. Discover Wordware’s new Slack-to-Podcast agent, see a 3-step setup, and learn top use-cases for remote teams.
body_markdown:
Tired of scrolling hundreds of messages to catch up? Let an[AI narrator](https://blog.wordware.ai/build-free-text-to-speech-tool) read you the highlights while you cook, commute, or work out.


---


## Why Your Team Needs Audio Slack Updates in 2025


-


**Slack overload is real.** Users send **≈ 1.5 billion messages every week** ([Business of Apps](https://www.businessofapps.com/data/slack-statistics/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) ), drowning important context in noise.


-


**Podcast listening keeps climbing.** Over **55 % of Americans 12+** are now monthly podcast consumers ([Podnews](https://podnews.net/press-release/edison-research-infinite-dial-2025?utm_source=chatgpt.com) ) - audio is the easiest way to absorb long-form content hands-free.


Put the two together and you get a simple insight: *your team will actually catch up if updates arrive as a podcast.*


---


## What Wordware’s Agent Actually Does


Feature


How it works


**Smart filtering**


Pull messages from selected channels or DMs, exclude noise with keyword rules.


**LLM summarization**


Condenses threads into a coherent script: who said what, why it matters, next steps.


**Voice generation**


Transforms the script into natural-sounding speech (11 voice presets, multilingual).


**Automatic publishing**


Drops the MP3 into a private RSS feed,[Notion page](https://blog-wordware.vercel.app/instantly-sync-your-ai-agents-with-notion-wordwares-one-click-integration) , or Google Drive folder.


**Schedule or on-demand**


Run hourly, daily, or trigger manually before your commute.


The 50-second video demo (link below) shows the agent going from **“#launch-updates”** to a polished 3-minute podcast in under 30 seconds ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qcCnEghYXRs&utm_source=chatgpt.com) ).


---


## 3-Step Quick-Start


1.


**Duplicate the template** Wordware → *Explore* → **“Slack to Podcast Agent”** → *Duplicate* .


2.


[Connect your Slack](https://blog.wordware.ai/announcing-our-integration-with-slack) **workspace** Paste the OAuth token (the template walks you through Slack’s *Add to Slack* dialog). Pick the channels you want.


3.


**Pick a voice & schedule** Choose a voice preset, set daily time (e.g., 5 p.m.), hit **Run** .


Typical run-time: **< 45 s** for 250 messages.

Team

---


## Tips for a Smooth Roll-Out


-


**Channel curation beats brute force.** Start with 1-2 high-signal channels to avoid 30-min episodes.


-


**Keep episode titles clear** : “Product-Stand-up · May 21 · 3 min”.


-


**Respect private data** : don’t include #hr-confidential or 1-1 DMs without permission.


-


**Invite feedback** after week 1—tweak summary length & voice speed.
